description: This is a Java source file for an Android activity named FoldingLayoutActivity. The activity demonstrates a paper-like folding visual effect by interacting with a custom FoldingLayout. It manages camera preview via TextureView, handles user interactions such as gestures and menu options, and applies visual effects like sepia filters. It includes logic for animations, orientation toggling, and dynamic configuration of the folding effect.

classes.name: FoldingLayoutActivity
classes.description: Main activity that manages the folding view, camera preview, user interactions, and visual effects for demonstration of paper-like folding.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up layout, views, camera, gesture detectors, and visual effect filters.

methods.name: setSepiaLayer
methods.description: Applies or removes a sepia color filter to the provided view, configuring hardware layer properties.

methods.name: mSurfaceTextureListener
methods.description: Handles camera preview setup upon the TextureView's surface availability, size changes, and destruction.

methods.name: mSeekBarChangeListener
methods.description: Updates the folding anchor point based on SeekBar progress.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates menu options for controlling fold animations, orientation, camera feed toggle, and sepia filter.

methods.name: onWindowFocusChanged
methods.description: Computes screen location of fold layout for gesture interaction logic.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Processes touch events to drive folding gestures.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for fold animations, orientation toggle, camera feed switch, and visual effects.

methods.name: animateFold
methods.description: Animates the fold layout inwards and outwards.

methods.name: ItemSelectedListener
methods.description: Handles selection of number of folds from a spinner, updating the fold count.

methods.name: ScrollGestureDetector
methods.description: Detects scroll gestures to dynamically fold/unfold the paper view based on user interaction.
